description: Java class for a custom JSP tag that generates product image URLs based on store configuration, SKU, image name, and size.

classes.name: ShopProductImageUrlTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag class for generating product image URLs with configurable size and store context.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and outputs the product image URL based on store configuration, SKU, image name, and size.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the tag processing, continues page evaluation.

methods.name: setImageName
methods.description: Sets the image name for the product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU for the product.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size parameter (SMALL or LARGE).
